summary: Flathead National Forest cabin: camp 1929, L-4 cab 1931, abandoned 1956 and now gone. A National Forest trail runs to Nasukoin Peak.

facts.status_note: Abandoned in 1956 and listed as gone; no source describes what, if anything, remains of the cabin site

access.note: A National Forest trail leads to Nasukoin Peak; no source describes access to the cabin site itself

visit.trail_note: 5.8 miles, rated high difficulty, from Red Meadow Creek roads 115 and 589 to Nasukoin Peak

events.note: Camp recorded at the site (firelookout.com gives only 'camp')

evidence.supports: FFLA lists a ground-level structure with status Gone
trail begins at Red Meadow Creek roads 115 and 589
evidence.quote: Trail Begins: Red Meadow Creek Roads 115 and 589.

evidence.supports: listed as a National Forest trail

notes_for_editor: The 1929, 1931 and 1956 dates and the Gone status rest on firelookout.com, which the FFLA list matches on Gone only. A second search found no staffing or fire history. The trail listing is used for access only; Gaia GPS and SummitPost add no lookout history. Record elevation_m is null; firelookout.com gives 8086 ft.
